## Finding 1 (MATERIAL) — per-channel audit projection
Replace the single exclusive-status projection in packages/core/scripts/create-dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle/ruleDispositions.ts:
- The audit coverage row per engine-procedure key carries independent channel facts: `implementation?` (authored runtimeOwner + evidence — the only fact still authored in the audit script), `adjudicationContext?` (the RULE_ADJUDICATION_CONTEXT entry by identity), `knownLimits` (ALL RULE_KNOWN_LIMITS entries for the key, by identity, any number, each with its own findingId). Remove the exclusivity throws (authored-both, more-than-one-place, exactly-one-limit). Keep: the authored table may contain only implementation evidence; every channel fact projects by identity (one definition per fact).
- Drop the single `status` as the row's identity. If a summary label is still needed anywhere, derive it and never use it to discard a channel fact. Update every consumer: `validateRuleDeterministicCapabilityContracts` (packages/core/src/rules/deterministicCapabilityLedger.ts reads `row.status === 'implemented'` — make it read the implementation fact; keep its contract otherwise unchanged), `buildRuleDispositionReport`, `validateRuleRegistries`, the GameplayReadinessReport types/formatting in cli.ts (count per channel: implementation, adjudication context, known limits by kind partial/unimplemented/deferred with their keys, and no-runtime-statement = keys with none; say in the formatted report that a key may count in several channels), and tests.
- Permanent evidence: a test of the REAL materializer with injected datasets where one key has authored implementation evidence AND an adjudication context AND two known limits — assert all four identities survive and the report counts the key in each channel; plus a key with no facts → no-runtime-statement. Keep the committed-data identity assertions (each projected fact `toBe` its runtime entry).
- Keep the 175-key set unchanged and the committed classification of each key's facts identical to d3ebc8ad except where findings 2–4 change data.

## Finding 2 — target-domain-correct condition mappings
add_condition/remove_condition are character-only; encounter combatants take conditions via update_combatant (args addCondition {id}, removeCondition id). Rewrite rule:being-prone, rule:falling, rule:grappling, rule:shoving-a-creature so the dmContext names both paths and which applies to which target (character → add_condition/remove_condition; encounter combatant → update_combatant), and list update_combatant in tools. Re-check every other entry that lists add_condition/remove_condition (the review cleared food, water, and speed's forced march as character-facing; confirm). Permanent evidence: extend the existing rule-awareness/A3 tests so those four entries must list and name update_combatant alongside the character tools.

## Finding 3 — rule:hiding must not reroll the retained Stealth total
resolve_contest rolls both sides; the source keeps the hider's Dexterity (Stealth) total. Rewrite: resolve the hider's Stealth check with resolve_check and keep its total; a later active search is the searcher's Wisdom (Perception) check via resolve_check with `vs` = that retained total; passive observers: calc passive_score compared to the total. tools: lookup_rules, resolve_check, calc (no resolve_contest). Permanent evidence: a source-backed assertion that rule:hiding does not list resolve_contest and its dmContext directs the retained total as the resolve_check DC (cite the source clause in a comment).

## Finding 4 — suffocation trap only
In RULE_KNOWN_LIMITS['rule:suffocating'] remove the breath-duration/countdown sentence; keep the adjust_hp instruction and the no-stabilization/no-HP-recovery trap. Keep the existing F1 source-fidelity assertion (tools.test.ts / ruleAwareness.test.ts) and add a discriminating assertion that the statement no longer contains the countdown/held-breath claim.

## General
Don't touch importer/pack/relationship files or docs/design/* (A3 revision is already written; if it is unworkable, stop and record why). Validators, invariant-12 overlap test, and discovery probe suites must stay green without budget changes. Completion notes: the new row shape, every consumer changed, before/after for the 6 changed entries, per-channel counts from the report, verify result.
